gloss: luggage storage area; baggage shelf; luggage rack

definitions.gloss: luggage storage area; baggage shelf; luggage rack
definitions.explanation: A designated place for storing luggage or belongings, such as overhead racks on trains, shelves in restaurants, or storage areas in buildings.

examples.japanese: {荷物置|にもつお}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧です。
examples.english: The luggage storage area is over there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{荷物置|にもつお}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧カバン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{載|の}せた→載せる：28290_noseru⟧。
examples.english: I put my bag on the luggage rack of the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{荷物置|にもつお}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A space for luggage storage was provided at the entrance of the restaurant.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ (luggage, baggage) + ⟦{置|お}き→置く：01092_oku⟧ (from ⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧, to place — used as a suffix meaning 'place for putting'). Refers to any designated area for storing bags and belongings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷物置|にもつお}き⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧: luggage storage space
- {荷物置|にもつお}き{場|ば}: luggage storage area (alternative form)
- {荷物置|にもつお}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to put something in the luggage area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{網棚|あみだな}→網棚：10195_amidana⟧: overhead luggage rack (on a train) — the mesh/net shelf above seats on Japanese trains
- {荷物棚|にもつだな}: baggage shelf — a shelf specifically for luggage
- ⟦ロッカー→ロッカー：09734_rokkaa⟧: locker — a lockable storage compartment, often coin-operated in Japan
